summary: Two buttons that open a left navigation drawer and a right settings drawer.
use: Slide-in panels for site navigation on mobile or for quick settings without leaving the page.
spec: `<Drawer bind:open={leftOpen} side="left" title="Navigation">` holds a `<nav class="nav" aria-label="Demo navigation">` with 4 links: Home, Components, Foundation, About
Left links close it with `onclick={() => (leftOpen = false)}`
`<Drawer bind:open={rightOpen} side="right" title="Settings">` lists 3 label and value rows: Theme Amber, Language English, Notifications Enabled
Triggers are `Button` with `variant="outlined"`, the second with `{#snippet leading()}<Settings size={16} stroke-width={2} />{/snippet}`
